---
title: "Research"
---

My research lies at the interface between quantum chaos and the AdS/CFT correspondence.



The AdS/CFT correspondence provides a framework for studying quantum gravity. It states that certain strongly interacting quantum field theories have an equivalent description in terms of a gravitational theory in an anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime. This duality allows questions about quantum gravity to be investigated using the corresponding quantum field theory.

Under generic conditions, strongly interacting and non-integrable quantum systems are expected to display quantum-chaotic behavior. Although the microscopic dynamics of such systems can be extremely complicated, quantum chaos gives rise to universal features, including characteristic energy-level statistics, thermalization, information scrambling, and operator growth.

According to the AdS/CFT correspondence, these universal features must also be reproduced by the dual gravitational theory in AdS. My research uses quantum chaos as a tool to constrain gravitational dynamics and to better understand the inner workings of quantum gravity and black holes.
